The Gift of the Brothers is found at in the Merciless Wastes of K'aresh. To reveal the container, first find Ihya and speak with the unbound ethereal. Then pick up the Flickering Lantern at Ihya's feet to gain a 15-minute buff: : The three brothers are Sahra at to the north, Naji at to the west, and M'alim at to the south: After finding the three brothers, return to Ihya at where the flickering lantern was at: : :They fade away and the buff gets removed. At Ihya's feet is the Gift of the Brothers container, which contains The Brothers' Final Gift for Treasures of K'aresh. The gift will contain The Brothers' Not-So-Final Present instead, if the appearance of the cosmetic item is already known

It collects the appearances of the warrior Season 1 armor, along with additional items that match visually but do not grant set bonuses. Collecting the entire set will grant The Original achievement. ;Head *Gladiator's Plate Helm ;Shoulders *Gladiator's Plate Shoulders ;Chest *Gladiator's Plate Chestpiece ;Hands *Gladiator's Plate Gauntlets ;Waist *General's Plate Belt (Kezzik the Striker, Area 52) *Marshal's Plate Belt (Kezzik the Striker, Area 52) ;Legs *Gladiator's Plate Legguards ;Feet *General's Plate Greaves (Kezzik the Striker, Area 52) *Marshal's Plate Greaves (Kezzik the Striker, Area 52)
